brand.name: Frame of Mind
brand.tagline: Films, philosophy, psychology, and the big ideas that shape how we see the world.
brand.description: Frame of Mind explores films, books, philosophy, and psychology — turning deep ideas into clear, honest, human writing for curious readers.

writer.name: Dasek Nahri
writer.bio: Dasek Nahri writes about film, philosophy, and psychology for Frame of Mind — taking deep ideas and making them simple, human, and worth thinking about. He watches closely, reads widely, and cares less about being clever than about being clear.
